items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Nat formed a trio with Wesley Prince... and Oscar Moore... we used to go by and share pots of ham hocks and beans

ctx.x: time was on the corner of Sunset and Vine. Oscar Moore was supposed to have shown up, and he didn't show up so we decided we'd do it, we'd just do it -- because we liked to play together. So this has since become a part of jazz history. Every now and then a new release turns up somewhere. We didn't really make any money for doing the date, because it wasn't a date; it was just for pleasure.
